strings.name: He Xiangjian
strings.role: Midea Group founder and supporter of scientific philanthropy
strings.summary: He Xiangjian founded Midea, building on a collective workshop in Shunde, Guangdong, to develop appliance manufacturing and shareholding reforms. He left the Group board in 2012, with Fang Hongbo succeeding as chairman. He subsequently pursued philanthropy and launched the He Science Foundation in 2023.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through 17 November 2026. Birth follows the regulatory disclosure of August 1942; recent foundation activity does not establish his attendance, and funding commitments do not mean all money has been disbursed.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded and developed Midea Group, advancing large-scale Chinese appliance manufacturing and global industrial supply chains.
strings.facts.f1.label: Business origins
strings.facts.f1.value: Started a venture with local residents in Beijiao, Shunde, in 1968 with RMB5,000; the early business made plastic products.
strings.facts.f2.label: Management succession
strings.facts.f2.value: Left the Midea Group board in 2012, when Fang Hongbo became chairman; founder status is distinct from a current management role.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Manufacturing and institutional reform
strings.highlights.h1.text: Helped transform Midea from a workshop into an appliance manufacturer, participating in its 1992 shareholding reform and subsequent development.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Supporting young researchers
strings.highlights.h2.text: Established a science foundation with personal funding to support young scientists; foundation operations and grant payments are distinct from personal wealth.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Foundation opened third-round nominations
strings.timeline.t1.text: The fellowship program added intelligent science; grant recipients are scheduled to be announced in 2027.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Joined the first fellowship event
strings.timeline.t2.text: The report's caption identifies him at the front center of a group photograph with young scientists; this account relies on the caption, with visual verification still pending.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Science foundation unveiled
strings.timeline.t3.text: Announced RMB3 billion in personal funding for the foundation at the Greater Bay Area Science Forum; he addressed the event by video.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Midea Group completed its overall listing
strings.timeline.t4.text: The Group listing came after he left the board and is distinct from Midea Electric's 1993 listing.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Left the Group board
strings.timeline.t5.text: Fang Hongbo succeeded as Midea Group chairman, taking over board leadership from the founder.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Midea Electric listed in Shenzhen
strings.timeline.t6.text: Following shareholding reform, Midea Electric shares were listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Entered appliance manufacturing
strings.timeline.t7.text: Midea began making electric fans, moving from its early workshop activities into appliances.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Started a venture in Beijiao, Shunde
strings.timeline.t8.text: Raised funds with local residents to establish the workshop that marked Midea's beginnings.
